howItWorks.title: How IET works
howItWorks.subtitle: Hassle-free, transparent, and welfare-first equine transit in 3 simple steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: Tell us your route, compare quotes from vetted drivers, and book the service you want. No phone tag, no guesswork, no shady operators.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Picture driving where the action is, and update how each step of the trip will develop with live GPS tracking, cabin sensors, and vital stats.
howItWorks.step3Desc: From the moment the ride confirms to the moment your horse walks off at the new barn, you know what's happening with signed e-POD reports.
